subject: radiology
title: Femoropopliteal and tibial revascularisation

steps.tx: Femoropopliteal disease narrows the main highway to the calf, so exertional calf pain dominates the early story. The patient reports cramping calves with absent popliteal pulses, and rest pain with ulcers marks advanced disease. A **drug coated balloon** delivers antiproliferative drug without permanent metal and suits a focal lesion well. A **nitinol scaffold** supports a long dissection or recoil when a balloon alone cannot hold the lumen. The operator avoids a **no stent zone** behind the knee and at hip flexion because repeated bending fractures metal.
steps.say: Femoropopliteal disease narrows the main highway to the calf so exertional calf pain dominates early. The patient reports cramping calves with absent pulses and rest pain with ulcers marks advanced disease. A coated balloon delivers antiproliferative drug without permanent metal and suits a focal lesion well. A flexible scaffold supports a long dissection or recoil when a balloon alone cannot hold. The operator avoids metal behind the knee because repeated bending fractures the scaffold there.

steps.tx: Calcium and lesion length dictate the tool, so preparation precedes any definitive treatment in hard disease. **Vessel preparation** with scoring or lithotripsy cracks calcium and the balloon then expands fully against the wall. A **dissection flap** that limits flow earns a spot stent rather than full metal coverage of the segment. A drug coated scaffold pairs drug delivery with support when the lesion stays complex after preparation. **Bypass surgery** serves a long occlusion with a good vein when endovascular attempts fail to cross the blockage.
steps.say: Calcium and lesion length are key because they dictate the tool and preparation precedes definitive treatment. Scoring or lithotripsy cracks calcium and the balloon then expands fully against the wall. A flap that limits flow is important because it earns a spot stent rather than full coverage. A drug coated scaffold pairs drug delivery with support when the lesion stays complex. Bypass surgery serves a long blockage with a good vein when wire attempts fail completely.

steps.tx: This knee angiogram shows a focal calcified stenosis in the femoral artery with a flap that lifts after balloon treatment. The brackets mark the lesion length and the **drug coated balloon** landing zone just beyond the diseased segment. Below the knee, the label warns against metal in the **no stent hinge zone**, where popliteal flexion bends the artery with every step. The image matters for the exam because preparation and landing zone choice decide durability. A spot solution preserves the hinge and leaves options open for later care.
steps.say: This knee angiogram shows a focal calcified narrowing in the femoral artery with a lifted flap. The brackets mark the lesion length and the landing zone for drug coated balloon treatment. Below the knee a label is important because it warns against metal where flexion bends the artery. Preparation and landing zone choice decide durability after femoral balloon treatment in the leg. A spot solution preserves the hinge and leaves options open for later care.

steps.tx: Below knee angioplasty feeds healing in a foot with tissue loss, because open tibial trunks deliver blood directly. **Infrapopliteal angioplasty** opens tibial vessels for a non healing ulcer where **straight line flow** to the foot matters most. **Angiosome targeting** aims treatment at the trunk that feeds the wound territory whenever anatomy allows that choice. **Pedal access** crosses an uncrossable cap retrogradely from below when antegrade attempts fail in the leg. Wound care with offloading continues alongside flow restoration, because flow alone never heals an ulcer without pressure relief.
steps.say: Below knee angioplasty feeds healing in a foot with tissue loss because open vessels deliver blood directly. Tibial angioplasty opens vessels for a non healing ulcer where direct flow to the foot matters. Wound directed targeting aims treatment at the trunk that feeds the wound territory whenever possible. Foot access crosses an uncrossable cap from below when antegrade attempts fail in the leg. Wound care with offloading continues alongside flow restoration because flow alone never heals ulcers.

vis.caption: Infrapopliteal revascularization for foot ulcers via angiosome-targeted angioplasty

steps.tx: Restenosis after femoropopliteal treatment returns silently first, so surveillance catches narrowing before symptoms recur. **Duplex surveillance** combined with a pressure index detects narrowing well before claudication returns to the calf. A focal recurrence earns **target lesion re ballooning** without stacking another metal layer inside the vessel. The team checks hinge zones with plain imaging because **stent fracture** clusters where repeated bending stresses the scaffold. Lifelong tablets with regular walking protect every femoropopliteal result and support lasting patency after treatment ends.
